name: COMMUNITY-NOTIFICATIONS-INBOX-AND-SUMMARY-STAGE2
status: implemented in knode-community; verified against loopback H2 (MySQL mode) and synthetic Auth/User/Content fixtures; native multi-service integration scheduled for Stage 5

publicApi.auth: required blog user JWT + live authoritative Redis session; receiver is always derived from verified principal

routes.behavior: Merges direct yan_user_notification rows and eligible large-author yan_author_publish_event read-fanout rows (negative ID -e.id, default isRead=1, e.create_time >= f.create_time, excluding community_publish_event_dismissal and non-PUBLIC community_article_projection rows) ordered by isRead ASC, createTime DESC, id DESC in one REPEATABLE READ SQL view. Enriches actor profiles via knode-user public-profiles:batch and article visibility/titles via knode-content notification-metadata:batch outside SQL transactions. Empty page makes zero external calls.
Counts only yan_user_notification rows with receiver_id=principal and is_read=0; read-fanout publish stream items are never counted as unread.

Accepts canonical non-zero signed int64 ID (|id| in 1..9223372036854775807; invalid -> HTTP 200 code 515). Positive ID updates receiver-owned unread row; negative ID is an idempotent no-op returning 200.
Marks all unread yan_user_notification rows owned by verified principal as is_read=1.

Positive ID deletes receiver-owned row in yan_user_notification. Negative ID (-publishEventId) records per-user dismissal in community_publish_event_dismissal only when receiver is eligible for that publish event, permanently hiding it for that receiver without affecting other followers or allowing arbitrary bogus ID bloat.

fields: id (signed int64 decimal string; negative for read-fanout publish stream)
rootCommentId (signed int64 decimal string, -1 for roots | null)
voContract.visibilityProtection: Fail-closed: DRAFT, WITHDRAWN, DELETED, and MISSING articles always return articleTitle=null and articleVisibilityStatus=UNAVAILABLE. When knode-content metadata lookup is unreachable/unconfigured, returns articleTitle=null and articleVisibilityStatus=TEMP_UNAVAILABLE without falling back to stale cached titles.

auth.machine: Required single Authorization: Bearer <service-jwt> (iss=knode-user, token_use=service, aud=knode-community, permission=community:notifications:read).
auth.receiver: Required single token header carrying verified blog user JWT + live authoritative Redis session. Rejects client-supplied query parameters such as receiverId (400 INVALID_ARGUMENT).

response.rules: Exact three fields {unreadCount, latestNotificationId, asOf}. unreadCount is canonical non-negative decimal string; latestNotificationId is signed decimal string of newest eligible notification or null when empty; asOf is UTC ISO-8601 instant.
